result.summary: The image shows a two-lane urban street with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and street trees are present, visibility is compromised by a large vehicle parked immediately adjacent to the crossing, and there are no active traffic control devices visible at this location.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large black pickup truck is parked directly at the edge of the crosswalk, severely blocking sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground, parked at the curb next to the crosswalk

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks any visible stop signs, signals, or pedestrian warning signs to alert drivers to yield.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the roadway.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-activated flashing lights to increase driver yielding rates at this uncontrolled crossing.
